def f(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]; pick=None
    for v in range(10):
        if v==bg: continue
        cs=comps(g,v)
        if len(cs)!=1: continue
        s=set(cs[0])
        rs=[a for a,b in cs[0]]; cls=[b for a,b in cs[0]]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cls)-min(cls)+1
        miss=h*w-len(s)
        if miss>0:
            pick=v
    if pick is None: return res
    for i,r in enumerate(res):
        for j,x in enumerate(r):
            if x==pick: res[i][j]=1
    return res

# reconstruct f from earlier successful state: recolor whole color to 1 iff that color has EXACTLY ONE single-component with a non-solid bounding box,

def cands(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    info={}
    for v in sorted({x for r in g for x in r}-{bg}):
        cl=comps(g,v)
        info[v]=[(c[0], set(c)) for c in cl]
        s=set(cl[0][0])
        rs=[a for a,b in s]; cls=[b for a,b in s]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cls)-min(cls)+1
        info[v]=[(len(cl), s, h,w,h*w-len(s))]
    return info
